description.value: The Station Taphouse is a restaurant and pub set inside Port Alberni's historic train station, blending heritage character with a modern hospitality concept. Connected to Twin City Brewing Company, it operates 24 rotating taps focused on local and regional BC craft beer, alongside a curated comfort-food menu, BC wines, and cocktails. It positions itself as a destination for both locals and travelers passing through the Alberni Valley.
